race.comment: TALKACHINO (8) looks well placed to rebound after finishing sixth as one of the better-backed runners in an Open over 1600m at Warren. His previous third at Dubbo, beaten a long neck in Open company, reads strongly for this, and he brings proven form at both this track and the distance with Jacob Stiff back aboard. COMONGIN (7) drops back from Saturday company after finishing second last in a Class 3 at Rosehill from the wide gate. Maps well for this and can return to form quickly. DIVINE CONCLUSION (10) trained locally and has put together two seconds in BM58 grade, most recently beaten a length at Wellington as favourite in an open market. Big jump in class and comes here in peak condition. HOW'S IT KEV (3) saves his best for this track and trip and strips fitter after a sound third in an Open at Dubbo, after being tightened near the 1000m. Can go on with it now.
